name: Adejo Yunusa
headline: Adejo|Yunusa
lead: I design and build interfaces that are fast, responsive, and easy to use. HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React, from concept to a clean site.
about: I'm a web developer and designer with a focus on clean visual design and smooth user experience. I work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React, and I use Git for version control and REST APIs to connect interfaces to real data.

I care about the details that make a site feel considered: consistent spacing, sensible interactions, and layouts that hold up on any screen size. I keep learning so the sites I build don't feel dated in a year.
I'm comfortable working directly with clients on scope and feedback.
